repos.name: nestjs-boilerplate
repos.why: NestJS auth plus alternative Postgres/MongoDB Compose profiles.

notes.unchanged: The 14 findings were unchanged by this fix set.
notes.known-gap: Alternative database profiles and the code/Compose gateway split remain unresolved. NestJS guards are detected but not linked to the Compose API gateway.

repos.name: cookiecutter-django
repos.why: Jinja-templated Django/Compose repository and external-service sink guard.

notes.fixed: DEAD-NODE dropped from 1 to 0 because reconstructed outbound destinations are explicit terminal nodes.
notes.known-gap: Unrendered Cookiecutter/Jinja Compose files are skipped; render the template for complete deployment topology.

repos.name: wild-workouts
repos.why: Go DDD microservices with HTTP, gRPC, Firestore, MySQL, CI and local Compose profiles.

notes.unchanged: The 13 findings were unchanged by this fix set.
notes.known-gap: Published gRPC ports are classified as HTTP gateways, CI/local Compose profiles are combined, and Firebase/JWT auth is not linked to every Compose gateway.

repos.name: backstage
repos.why: Large TypeScript monorepo; primary guard for production scope, Storybook filtering, external sinks, and OpenAPI security propagation.

notes.fixed: On the canonical pinned checkout, findings dropped from the observed pre-fix 33 to 4 and nodes from 90 to 76.
notes.known-gap: The historical snapshot came from a directory named validation-target-backstage. Root service identity currently depends on the checkout basename; the corpus directory is canonically named backstage, which unifies that root with the declared gateway.

repos.name: airflow

notes.fixed: Findings dropped from 19 to 7 and nodes from 34 to 21.
notes.known-gap: The root service aggregates optional database providers; three Helm placeholder resources remain in production template directories.

repos.name: keycloak
